{{Quote|A Wookiee warrior without a ryyk blade is a webweaver without fangs.|Traditional Wookiee maxim|<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />}}
'''Ryyk blades''' were traditional [[Sword/Legends|swords]] constructed and used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Description==
[[File:Ryyk_blades2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Two ryyk blade variants]]
The design of these weapons varied greatly between individuals since all ryyk blades were handcrafted. Generally, the blade was a broad, curved design and the handle was wrapped in leather.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" /> Wookiees could wield them with surprising speed and grace. Wookiees would sometimes wield two blades at the same time in a graceful and deadly two-weapon fighting style.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> Because of its exotic design and craftsmanship, a user required training to wield a Ryyk blade proficiently.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />

For a non-Wookiee to use the ryyk without earning the right to do so was an insult to most Wookiees. A non-Wookiee would be advised to be able to understand [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] and provide a good explanation why they were using the weapon.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide" /> [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] would carry ryyk blades from captured Wookiees just to mock them.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />

A variant blade of the ryyk blade was called the [[Ryyk kerarthorr/Legends|ryyk kerarthorr]].<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

==History==
[[File:RyykBlade-TNR.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Ryyk blades were deadly in a Wookiee's hands]]
The blade was first developed when the Wookiees were still technologically primitive; they were used for clearing paths through the thick forests of Kashyyyk and fending off vicious predators and other attacking animals. They were also used for hunting, and if necessary, combat.

The [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] once killed a pack of twenty [[Katarn/Legends|katarns]] using a single ryyk blade, though he kept his achievement secret until his son [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] happened to find the katarn [[Claw/Legends|claws]] years later.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

Ryyk blades were used heavily by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and by Wookiee [[Berserker]]s during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], used the weapon.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" /> Wookiees armed with ryyk blades came to the defense of Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] while she was pregnant on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to protect her from [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Noghri Death Commando]]s.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Agents of Chaos Duology]]'', the blades are misspelled as "ryyyk" blades.

In ''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]'', the blade of Chewbacca is misspelled as a "ryk" blade.
